SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS customer_count
FROM customers
WHERE customer_state = 'SP'
  AND customer_unique_id IS NOT NULL;

SELECT customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS customer_count
FROM customers
WHERE customer_unique_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY customer_state
ORDER BY customer_count DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
WHERE order_status IN ('delivered', 'canceled')
GROUP BY order_status
ORDER BY order_status
LIMIT 10;

SELECT campaign_name, ROUND(SUM(budget), 2) AS total_budget
FROM campaigns
GROUP BY campaign_name
LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.customer_state
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_state
HAVING COUNT(*) > 5000
LIMIT 100;

-- 差评订单按客户所在州计数：order_reviews 关联 orders 再关联 customers
SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS bad_review_orders
FROM order_reviews r
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE r.review_score <= 2
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY bad_review_orders DESC
LIMIT 30;

SELECT category_id,
       ROUND((AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (resolved_at - created_at)) / 3600.0))::numeric, 2) AS avg_hours
FROM support_tickets
WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY category_id
ORDER BY category_id
LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.macro_region, ml.level_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS sales
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = s.seller_state
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN members m ON m.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id
JOIN member_levels ml ON ml.level_id = m.level_id
GROUP BY r.macro_region, ml.level_name
ORDER BY sales DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS customer_count

SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders

WITH monthly AS (SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS month, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017) AS orders_2017, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018) AS orders_2018 FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01' GROUP BY 1) SELECT MONTH, orders_2017, orders_2018, ROUND(100.0 * (orders_2018 - orders_2017) / NULLIF(orders_2017, 0), 2) AS yoy_growth_pct FROM monthly WHERE orders_2018 > 0 ORDER BY MONTH LIMIT 201

SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS bad_review_order_count
FROM order_reviews r
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE r.review_score IN (1, 2)
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY c.customer_state
LIMIT 100;

SELECT s.carrier,
       ROUND((AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (o.order_delivered_customer_date - o.order_purchase_timestamp)) / 86400.0))::numeric, 2) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM shipments s
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id
WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.carrier
ORDER BY avg_delivery_days DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT st.category_id,
       ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (st.resolved_at - st.created_at)) / 3600.0)::numeric, 2) AS avg_processing_hours
FROM support_tickets st
WHERE st.resolved_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY st.category_id
ORDER BY st.category_id
LIMIT 100;

SELECT s.seller_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pct.product_category_name_english) AS category_cnt,
       ROUND(SUM(si.commission_amount), 2) AS total_commission
FROM settlements s
JOIN settlement_items si ON s.settlement_id = si.settlement_id
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = si.order_id AND oi.order_item_id = si.order_item_id
LEFT JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
LEFT JOIN product_category_translation pct ON pct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
GROUP BY s.seller_id
ORDER BY total_commission DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')) AS order_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')) AS unique_buyers, (SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')) AS aov LIMIT 201
